name: API Gateway Blue-Green Deployment Automation
summary: Automate blue-green deployments for APIs in AWS API Gateway to minimize downtime during updates.
description: This project focuses on implementing an automated blue-green deployment strategy for APIs hosted on AWS API Gateway. The goal is to ensure seamless updates with minimal downtime, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. The process involves setting up two identical environments, 'blue' and 'green', where one serves live traffic while the other is updated. Once the new version is tested and verified in the inactive environment, traffic is switched over, allowing for quick rollbacks if issues arise. This automation will be achieved through AWS services such as Lambda, CloudFormation, and CodePipeline, ensuring a robust CI/CD pipeline. The project will also include comprehensive documentation and training for your team to manage and maintain the deployment process effectively. By automating this process, your organization can significantly reduce deployment risks and accelerate time-to-market for new features.
